method: Fry the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli paste in oil, add the main ingredient and water, cook until the water is gone and the oil separates.
notes: Drafted by Claude from general knowledge (2026-11-01); not yet checked against published recipes. Fresh bamboo shoot stands in for pickled. One spoon = one serving spoon with its oil; weigh a few to set servingG.
